_meta.label: Votion
_meta.summary: Vote-optimization tool for TLA (and Hydro). Helps voters direct voting power to maximize bribe returns, and is a data source for vote/bribe intelligence.

facts.claim: Votion is a vote-optimization tool for TLA and Hydro: it helps holders allocate voting power across pools to maximize returns from bribes.
facts.notes: Role known from existing TLA docs content; canonical Votion doc section to confirm. (2026-09-27: source was votion.io — an unrelated smart-home company; Votion is votion.money.)

facts.claim: Votion's bribe/vote data is relevant to TLA Vote Intelligence — including bribe-source attribution and VP-swing-by-briber as a centralization-health signal.
facts.notes: (2026-09-27: source was votion.io — an unrelated smart-home company; Votion is votion.money.)

facts.claim: Votion is a vote-aggregation/optimization app supporting BOTH Liquidity Alliance and Hydro pools (multi-ecosystem). Docs: it 'gathers reward information from the pools', 'estimates expected USD rewards for different vote distributions', and 'suggests vote allocations'.
Votion's official docs repository is hosted under the erisprotocol GitHub org — extending the sourced pattern that Eris built the ve3 gauge system, the TLA hub, and PD's treasury contract.

The allocation algorithm, re-optimization cadence, and fee schedule are NOT published in votion-docs (user-facing pages only, read in full 2026-08-21). Any statement about how Votion responds to bribes must be labeled a model with visible assumptions. Audit: none found at SCV or Oak.
facts.notes: Bribe Planner v2 response model stays 'modeled, mechanics-only'.

facts.claim: A Votion vault re-votes a bucket only when its re-solve gains more than $0.05 AND its split differs by more than 5%; it casts about 2.6 h before the Sunday 23:59 UTC deadline.
facts.notes: 27,196 of 27,196 captured decisions (periods 196-204); fitted from Votion's published worksheets, not stated by Votion.
